title: Calendar
nobody: No agent has touched this yet. Mention it to one in a chat.

how.watching: is keeping an eye on it

empty.title: Your calendar isn't connected yet
empty.body: Paste a Google / iCloud calendar link (the secret iCal address). Your agents' work is already below.

feeds.title: My calendars
feeds.body: Paste a Google / iCloud calendar link (iCal, read-only). Your events show up in Calendar next to what your agents do, and agents can see when you're free.
feeds.name: Name (optional)
feeds.how: Where do I find this link?
feeds.howGoogle: Google Calendar: web → Settings → pick the calendar → "Secret address in iCal format".
feeds.howIcloud: iCloud: Calendar app → share button next to the calendar → Public Calendar → copy link.
feeds.howPhone: Add as many links as you like (work, home, the kids' school). Each one gets its own colour.
